This is the Sachs flow cytometry dataset. In the data, praf and pjnk are only weakly correlated (r = 0.19). That correlation is explained by the common upstream regulators PKC and PKA, which feed into both Raf and JNK. The accepted signaling network has no direct edge between Raf and JNK in either direction, so the most likely answer is that there is no direct causal relationship.

This rests mainly on my recollection of the published network, with the correlation check as supporting evidence. I did not run a causal-discovery test on the data.

ANSWER: C
